{{Top|leg}}
A '''plasma forge''' was a device used to create replacement components from raw material. A dangerous amount of heat was released in the process, but the forge doors and a security system ensured safety. The maintenance section of the [[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]] had one of these devices.
